title: Report your new address to USCIS (AR-11)
rule: Noncitizens in the US must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days of moving, using Form AR-11 (online, free). Changing your address with the Post Office does not update USCIS. Exceptions include A and G visa holders and visa waiver (ESTA) visitors. If you have pending USCIS applications, update each one.
notes: Checked 2026-10-24 against several legal clinic and law firm summaries citing INA 265, not yet against uscis.gov itself.
